name: Equinox Golf Resort & Spa
positioning: Historic four-season Vermont resort in the heart of Manchester, surrounded by the Green Mountains, with a championship golf course and a full-service spa
best_for: Travelers who want a historic New England inn with mountain views
Hikers, golfers and outdoor lovers in any season
Families or groups wanting suites with kitchens or a private house

facts.text: The Equinox was originally established in 1769 as Marsh Tavern, Vermont's oldest hotel and a gathering place for Ethan Allen's Green Mountain Boys.
The resort is set in the heart of Manchester, Vermont, and is a four-season destination.
The resort is surrounded by the Green Mountains and has a championship golf course, a full-service spa and year-round outdoor activities.
Guests have unlimited access to 850 acres of private hiking trails at the Equinox Preservation Trust.
The Charles Orvis Inn is a 19th-century building adjacent to the Main Inn, with a library, a fireplace sitting room and a New England-style porch.
Orvis Inn suites have a living room with a fireplace, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen and a marble bath.
The Dormy House is a bi-level private home overlooking the first tee of the golf course.
The Spa at The Equinox has a sauna and steam room, a 24-hour fitness and yoga studio, an indoor lap pool and an outdoor whirlpool.
The spa holds Sound Bath sessions that combine water, sound and stillness in the spa pool.
The Land Rover Experience at The Equinox teaches expedition-style off-road driving over obstacles such as steep inclines and rock crawls.
The resort fee includes resort bikes for riding in town or on trails, plus sleds and children's snowshoes for winter.
Falcon Bar's seating area offers Green Mountain views through original windows.

highlights.text: The bi-level Cupola Suite in the Main Inn has a king bedroom, a separate upstairs living room and 360-degree mountain views from its cupola.
The bi-level, one-bedroom Green Mountain Suite in the Main Inn overlooks the mountains and has a king bedroom, a separate living room and a dining area.
Meadow House is a free-standing home in a quiet meadow overlooking the Green Mountains and a reflecting lily pond, on the edge of Manchester Village.

The spa uses local products and draws on Vermont's natural beauty, with treatments such as a Maple Sugar body scrub and the Spirit of Vermont, which combines essential oils, massage, reflexology and Reiki.
The property is the birthplace of the local Council of Safety during the American Revolution.

considerations.text: Guests must be at least 21 years old to check in.
Stays carry a nightly resort fee plus a Historic Preservation Fund charge and a Community Impact Fee on top of taxes.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for golf and spa services.
